---
title: "Menzerath null model, real data"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(lmerTest)
set.seed(2137)

d <- fread("Data_Output/gestures_long.csv")
names(d)
```

## Data

```{r}
d <- d[n_submovements > 1]
d[, gid := paste(corpus, speaker, gesture_id)]
d[, sub_dur := subm_dur_ms / 1000]
d[, n_sub := n_submovements]

# n_submovements counts peaks; rows are the intervals between them
d <- d[, if (.N == n_sub[1] - 1) .SD, by = gid]

# gesture duration in seconds, onset to offset from the annotation
# change gesture_dur_ms to the name of that column in Wim's file
d[, gesture_dur := duration_ms / 1000]

g <- d[condition == "gesture"]
o <- d[condition == "objman"]
```

## Functions

```{r}
paper_model <- function(d, re = "(1 | corpus/speaker/gid)") {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, x := scale(log(n_sub))[, 1]]
  d[, y := scale(log(sub_dur))[, 1]]
  lmer(as.formula(paste("y ~ x +", re)), data = d)
}

sim_gesture <- function(dur, mean_iv, gap = 0.1) {
  for (i in 1:1000) {
    t <- cumsum(gap + rexp(ceiling(dur / gap) + 2, 1 / (mean_iv - gap)))
    t <- t - runif(1) * t[1]
    iv <- diff(t[t <= dur])
    if (length(iv) >= 1) return(iv)
  }
  NULL
}

null_slopes <- function(d, nsim = 100, re = "(1 | corpus/speaker/gid)") {
  gest <- unique(d[, .(corpus, speaker, gid, gesture_dur, n_sub)])
  gest[, mean_iv := sum(gesture_dur) / sum(n_sub + 1), by = .(corpus, speaker)]
  for (r in 1:3) {
    s <- gest[, .(n = length(sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv)) + 1), by = gid]
    gest[s, on = "gid", n_sim := i.n]
    gest[, mean_iv := 0.1 + (mean_iv - 0.1) * mean(n_sim) / mean(n_sub), by = .(corpus, speaker)]
  }
  sapply(1:nsim, function(k) {
    s <- gest[, .(sub_dur = sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv)), by = .(corpus, speaker, gid)]
    s[, n_sub := .N + 1, by = gid]
    unname(fixef(paper_model(s, re))["x"])
  })
}
```

## Observed

```{r}
m_g <- paper_model(g)
summary(m_g)$coefficients
VarCorr(m_g)

m_o <- paper_model(o, "(1 | speaker/gid)")
summary(m_o)$coefficients
```

## Null

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
null_g <- null_slopes(g)
null_o <- null_slopes(o, re = "(1 | speaker/gid)")
```

```{r}
obs_g <- fixef(m_g)[["x"]]
obs_o <- fixef(m_o)[["x"]]
res <- rbind(
  gestures      = c(observed = obs_g, null_mean = mean(null_g),
                    quantile(null_g, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null_g <= obs_g)) / 101),
  manipulations = c(observed = obs_o, null_mean = mean(null_o),
                    quantile(null_o, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null_o <= obs_o)) / 101))
round(res, 3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(null_g, main = "gestures", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null_g, obs_g))
abline(v = obs_g, col = "red")
hist(null_o, main = "object manipulations", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null_o, obs_o))
abline(v = obs_o, col = "red")
```
